description:
## [2.3.0](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/compare/v2.2.1...v2.3.0) (2026-11-18)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **brave:** add experimental privacy patches for v2.2.4 ([8b2ac3f](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/8b2ac3f3cad226e9a94279c64420a3a4a6bba10c))
* **instagram:** avoid register exhaustion in Change like animation ([5de3b6a](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/5de3b6aa74e315222d7c9ba705a45b9920e392b8))
* **instagram:** make like-animation register allocation robust ([240a3ad](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/240a3ad51a670b3e173a4123c911a41ec69dfc66))
* **mereframe:** contain the native integrity throw in every bridge wrapper ([788c131](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/788c131eb0986fc1bae4075ffb27bc7a3b619079)), closes [#5](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/issues/5) [ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches#5](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/issues/5)
* **mereframe:** degrade to the sweep when the pinned session wrapper drifts ([2a07249](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/2a07249feb2fdad0d3d13e559d994a85b55d827b))
* **mereframe:** make the Stage 2 sweep key natives correctly and guard every wrapper ([4e37212](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/4e37212844c928590677bd7460bf61fff95550b7)), closes [arity#returnType](https://github.com/ineednotitle/arity/issues/returnType)
* **mereframe:** match opcode names case-insensitively in the Stage 2 sweep ([2c9495f](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/2c9495f9d0d49eead78465c0c1acb64ec20fe575))
* **patches:** update Meesho package, Amazon Business/ads/autoplay/screenshot, and Mereframe native bypass/Pro ([46f7362](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/46f73628311383e568cd3974cf94582c720775b6))
* **pinterest:** run URL tests without Android unit-test task ([4c55433](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/4c55433c1c635498bbdc910cbaa4b38b865173fc))
* **readme:** render app summaries and add donation buttons [skip ci] ([4320123](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/4320123f51dbfe51f53c9632b1d6d4d4086119ec))
* **reddit:** discover comment TreeData by constructor shape ([ac6bcc7](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/ac6bcc75e0a046c298903d6b201d796a437d72e5))
* **reddit:** match rotated external-browser helper types [skip ci] ([6c25bc5](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/6c25bc510338ef21c0e2f655948cadc2ae8cdba9))
* **reddit:** restore tombstone-rendered deleted comments [skip ci] ([ea4f805](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/ea4f8059d9b5e80e118c2d49c40df290998c1c0a))
* retain license texts in Android bundle ([1c3d6fe](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/1c3d6fee8b32140dfa4828f00d585aa45fa5b1bd))
* **test:** remove stray token from InstagramPatchTest import ([4a52fa6](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/4a52fa62b7f3b34f1c6657eb6ba74cbf589ad6de))
* **universal:** improve permission controls and rebuild 2.2.2 bundle ([7f4d195](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/7f4d195d39e33e8b6314e2949f317cc8220db0d8))

### ✨ New Features

* **instagram:** add Instagram 439.0.0.37.89 patch suite and CI verification ([3c7e00f](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/3c7e00f0e5ab310d7de6a0f32f068582fd33c207))
* **instagram:** add settings UI, Ghost Mode, Reels controls and tools ([94c01ea](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/94c01eadab926cc6a292125cb5edcfe07f8d27c6))
* **pinterest:** add experimental video download ([66bf9fb](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/66bf9fbe012e7afa04ac9a4b7c26100006fbbaff))
* Reddit listing filters and Mereframe Pro unlock (v2.2.10) [skip ci] ([30be24e](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/30be24e1e51886d05b2d26ac6b609d1fe52eaf8f))
* **reddit:** add comment-tree hooks and support section [skip ci] ([9548465](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/9548465511ac184b9e526acf1f77e09729c84242))
* **release:** expand Proton Pass and Gboard patches for v2.2.10 ([2a54826](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/2a548265f4a57f3b54f607f7d15e8d6313823229))
* **universal:** optimize all 24 patches and add category-toggled aggressive permission removal (v2.2.2) ([1420f3e](https://github.com/ineednotitle/Proteus-Patches/commit/1420f3ecec508e871f42c161200f32dc11456bd0))

patches.name: Inure — Unlock Full Version (GitHub)
patches.description: Bypasses the 15-day trial gate and unlocks all premium features in Inure App Manager (GitHub).

patches.name: Unlock Full Version
patches.description: Bypasses the 15-day trial gate and unlocks all premium features in Inure App Manager.

patches.name: Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs
patches.description: Neutralizes Mereframe's install-integrity checks so patched (re-signed) builds start normally instead of showing the installation-refused screen. Required for any other patch here to be usable.

patches.name: Bypass native integrity checks
patches.description: Neutralizes libunnamed_raw.so's five ARM64 self-integrity gates (BTI/PAC-safe) and wraps the session-opening plus every other native-calling bridge wrapper in a real JVM try/catch that fails open on integrity errors. Required together with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs'.

patches.name: Diagnostic crash log
patches.description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - writes the full stack trace to Downloads/mereframe-crash-*.txt when the app crashes, for remote diagnosis. Off by default; enable when asked to produce a crash log. Chain-forwards to the original crash handler.

patches.name: Unlock Pro features
patches.description: Unlocks all Mereframe Pro features locally across both the Kotlin entitlement resolver (Qu.k/m) and the native license/session verifier (Bf1c089 + libunnamed_raw.so), eliminating paywall popups and capture/editor SecurityException crashes. Pair with 'Allow re-signed/sideloaded installs' and 'Bypass native integrity checks'.

patches.name: Unlock VPN Plus
patches.description: Injects max tier (3=PMTeam) into VpnUser at construction for all UI unlocks, while routing connections through free servers for server-side compatibility. Phone and TV

patches.name: Amazon: Stop feed video autoplay
patches.description:
Stops Amazon's home-feed native video units (live promotional videos,
review carousels, sponsored reels) from starting on their own, using
the same setPlayWhenReady(true) → false heuristic as the universal
'Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer/Media3)' patch.

Covers native ExoPlayer/Media3 players only — NOT the in-app WebView
pages (use the default-on 'Disable video autoplay' patch for those),
and NOT WebView CSS-injected ad blocks (use 'Remove ads'). Heuristic:
reflection or obfuscated player setup is not covered. Can stop playback
entirely in apps whose only play path is a flipped literal call — turn
it off if videos never start. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Block Sentry telemetry
patches.description: Disables Sentry crash/error/performance telemetry entirely by neutralizing the configurator that writes the DSN - with no DSN set, Sentry self-disables. Fixes nothing to break: the configurator's return is void and unused. Verified against 1.261023.20.

patches.name: Block analytics & data collection
patches.description: Neutralizes Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, CleverTap event fan-out and the in-house crash-report enqueue of District by Zomato.

patches.name: Block location tracking
patches.description: Stops District by Zomato from acquiring GPS fixes (continuous updates + one-shot fetch). Manual city selection still works.

patches.name: Block Motion Sensors
patches.description: Attempts to disable Chromium's Android sensor provider; may also block ambient sensors. Requires device validation.

patches.name: Block Popups & Ratings
patches.description: Disables the identified rating and Brave Ads signup eligibility checks; other dialogs can still appear.

patches.name: Block Telemetry
patches.description: Blocks usage analytics, crash uploads and experiment downloads.

options.description: Also blocks the shopping offers server. Turn off to keep it.

patches.name: Brave Origin
patches.description: Unlocks Brave Origin feature switches across Rewards, News, Wallet, and VPN.

patches.name: Clean New Tab
patches.description: Removes sponsored wallpapers, news feed and promo cards.

options.description: Removes most-visited tiles for a blank start page.

patches.name: Close Tab In Group Order
patches.description: Selects the previous tab in the tab group when closing a tab.

patches.name: Custom Brave theme
patches.description: Applies custom colors to Brave dark mode chrome, defaulting to pure OLED black for battery saving on OLED screens.

options.description: Opaque hexadecimal color for primary backgrounds and base window chrome. Defaults to pure OLED black (#000000).
When enabled, cards, sheets, and dialogs share the primary background color. When disabled, elevated surfaces use the dedicated surface color below.
Opaque hexadecimal color for elevated surfaces such as cards, sheets, and dialogs. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.
Opaque hexadecimal color applied to primary text labels. Defaults to Brave light slate ink (#f0f2ff).
Opaque hexadecimal color for interactive highlights, active switches, and links. Defaults to Brave purple-blue accent (#737ade).
Prevents Android 12+ wallpaper palette extraction from replacing dark surfaces. When disabled, dynamic system colors take precedence.
Opaque hexadecimal color for root window backgrounds in two-tier surface mode. Defaults to pure black (#000000).
Opaque hexadecimal color for preference item cards in Settings. Defaults to OLED black (#000000); use #1e2029 for visible depth between tiers.
Wraps settings and preference rows in rounded card shapes when two-tier surfaces are enabled.
When enabled, scales text brightness across primary, secondary, and disabled tiers using luminance ratios. When disabled, applies the text ink color uniformly.
Rewrites Android system neutral and surface container color roles in values-v31+ directories to theme colors.
Rewrites tonal luminance selectors in color resources to match custom background and container surfaces.
Rewrites hardcoded background and container fill colors inside vector drawables to match theme colors.

patches.name: Preserve last active tab
patches.description: Disables the identified new-tab opening-screen override after inactivity. Does not prevent tab unloading under memory pressure.

patches.name: Remove Extra Languages
patches.description: Replaces larger unselected Chromium locale PAKs with the English fallback; gender variants and Android resources are not removed.

options.description: Comma-separated language codes such as en-US, fr, hi. English is always kept; choosing a language keeps all its regions.

patches.name: Remove Unused AI & VPN
patches.description: Deletes unused AR and XR files to shrink the app.

options.description: Also deletes the WireGuard library. Brave VPN stops working.

patches.name: Skip Welcome Screens
patches.description: Reports the first-run flow complete; may skip essential consent, search or setup screens.

patches.name: Stop Background Wakeups
patches.description: Disables the identified Chromium background-sync scheduler gate; other wakeups remain and site background sync can break.

patches.name: Stop Promo Notifications
patches.description: Disables identified Chromium tips and retention notification entry points; other notifications may remain.

patches.name: Stop Text Sharing with System
patches.description: Disables Chromium's OnscreenContentProvider content-capture gate, not every possible text-sharing mechanism.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Makes Google Photos dark surfaces true black.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs Google Photos beside the system Photos app by changing package, permissions, providers, and app name.

options.description: Package name for the cloned Google Photos app.
Launcher name for the cloned Google Photos app.

patches.name: Custom branding
patches.description: Adds an option to replace the Google Photos launcher icon.

options.description:
Folder containing a Morphe adaptive icon set.

Supported density folders:
- mipmap-mdpi
- mipmap-hdpi
- mipmap-xhdpi
- mipmap-xxhdpi
- mipmap-xxxhdpi

Each included density folder must contain:
- morphe_adaptive_background_custom.png
- morphe_adaptive_foreground_custom.png

Optional themed icon:
- drawable/morphe_adaptive_monochrome_custom.xml

patches.name: Enable DCIM folders backup control
patches.description: Allows controlling Camera and other DCIM folder backup individually.

patches.name: Fix DCIM folder classification
patches.description: Prevents non-Camera DCIM folders from being grouped as Camera.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Adds MicroG/GmsCore support metadata for Google Photos.

patches.name: Spoof features
patches.description: Spoofs selectable Pixel Photos build and feature flags.

options.description: Device profile used for Build fields and Pixel feature levels.
Optionally spoof Build.VERSION fields. Follow profile uses the selected Pixel's matching Android version.
Force newer Pixel feature flags off when the selected profile should not have them.

patches.name: Disable Bluetooth voice routing
patches.description: Treats every Bluetooth audio device as an unusable car device so Gboard voice typing keeps using the built-in microphone.

patches.name: Offline-only voice typing & telemetry reduction
patches.description:
On Gboard 18.5.4.993608717 arm/arm64, routes core voice typing only through the on-device
recognizers and returns no recognizer when a local provider/model is unavailable (no
online fallback). Disables Agentic Dictation's server/batch retry path, reduces selected
metrics/telemetry and disables app backup. INTERNET and unrelated network features are
retained; this is best-effort telemetry reduction, not a guarantee of zero Google traffic.

Requires the appropriate offline speech model/provider to be installed. Without one,
voice typing is unavailable by design. Agentic Dictation is disabled.

patches.name: Hindustan Times: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Blocks Hindustan Times' analytics & tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics,
AppsFlyer, Adjust, WebEngage, CleverTap and similar) using the same universal
heuristic as 'Block analytics & tracking SDKs'.

Applies to com.ht.news only. Heuristic; obfuscated or reflection-based
reporting is not covered. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Hindustan Times: Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer)
patches.description:
Stops video autoplay in the Hindustan Times feed/article bodies
(ExoPlayer/Media3) using the same heuristic as 'Disable video autoplay
(ExoPlayer/Media3)'.

Applies to com.ht.news only. Heuristic; see the universal entry for
limitations. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Hindustan Times: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
patches.description:
Opens links in the default external browser instead of an in-app Custom
Tab, using the same rewrite as the universal 'Prefer external browser
over Custom Tabs' patch.

Applies to com.ht.news only. Some article WebViews are not affected —
this covers Custom Tabs / CustomTabsIntent call sites only.
Unverified on device.

patches.name: Mint: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Blocks Mint's analytics & tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust,
WebEngage, CleverTap and similar) using the same universal heuristic as
'Block analytics & tracking SDKs'.

Applies to com.htmedia.mint only. Heuristic; obfuscated or reflection-based
reporting is not covered. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Mint: Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer)
patches.description:
Stops video autoplay in the Mint feed/article bodies (ExoPlayer/Media3)
using the same heuristic as 'Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer/Media3)'.

Applies to com.htmedia.mint only. Heuristic; see the universal entry for
limitations. Unverified on device.

Applies to com.htmedia.mint only. Some article WebViews are not affected

Unverified on device.

patches.name: Bypass signature check
patches.description: Bypasses Instagram's internal provider signature verification after patching.

patches.name: Change like animation
patches.description: Lets you choose one of Instagram's built-in double-tap like animations, or pick a random one per session, from the Proteus settings dialog. Experimental on builds where Instagram renamed the animation classes.

patches.name: Clone
patches.description: Changes the package name and the app name so you can install the patched app alongside the official Instagram app. Caution: Do not combine with the universal "Change package name" patch.

options.description: A new package name for the patched app.
A new app name (label). Entering "Instagram" will skip changing the app name.

patches.name: Disable Reels scrolling
patches.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.

patches.name: Disable story auto flipping
patches.description: Disable stories automatically flipping/skipping after some seconds.

patches.name: Disable video autoplay
patches.description: Disable video autoplay from feed.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Hides typing indicators, prevents DM read receipts, and best-effort blocks story view receipts. Controlled at runtime from the Proteus settings button.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Hides Instants from DMs page.

patches.name: Hide Reels save button
patches.description: Hides the save button from Reels.

patches.name: Hide Threads profile button
patches.description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes ads from the Instagram feed and stories.

patches.name: Hide all stories
patches.description: Hides all stories from the tray in the feed page. You may need to clean app data after the initial use of this patch to see its effects.

patches.name: Hide explore feed
patches.description: Hides posts and reels from the explore/search page.

patches.name: Hide feed content
patches.description: Hide the feed content, leaving only stories in the home page.

patches.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches.description: Hides navigation bar buttons, such as the Reels and Create button. Choose what button to hide using the patch options.

options.description: Permanently hides the Home button. App starts at next available tab.
Permanently hides the Reels button.
Permanently hides the Direct button.
Permanently hides the Search button.
Permanently hides the Profile button.
Permanently hides the Create button.

patches.name: Hide notes tray
patches.description: Hides the notes tray from the direct tab.

patches.name: Hide reshare button
patches.description: Hides the reshare button from both posts and reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested content
patches.description: Choose the suggested content to hide using the patch options.

options.description: Hides suggested reels from feed and reels tab.
Hides suggested stories/users from story tray.
Hides highlighted stories from story tray, sponsored stories which have no set expiration.
Hides suggested accounts from the list of followers and from other profiles.

patches.name: Limit feed to following profiles
patches.description: Filters the home feed to display only chronological content from profiles you follow.

patches.name: Proteus settings
patches.description: Adds settings and Ghost Mode buttons to the Instagram feed action bar. The dialog controls the runtime options of the other Instagram patches.

patches.name: Reels double-tap seek
patches.description: Enables double-tap skip/rewind controls in Reels. The controls can be disabled at runtime from the Proteus settings button.

patches.name: Reels playback speed menu
patches.description: Adds Instagram's playback-speed menu to the Reels overflow menu. The speed can be changed at runtime from the Proteus settings button.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Removes the popup that appears after a while when the app version ages.

patches.name: Remove tracking & analytics
patches.description: Kills Facebook auto-init and OneSignal, and opts Firebase Crashlytics/Performance/Analytics out of collection at boot, in Everything Widgets. Widget functionality is unaffected; OneSignal push notifications stop.

patches.name: Spoof Play Store signature
patches.description: Forces the Google license (Pairip) verdict branch to LICENSED and neutralizes the license payload's signature verification, so the patched/re-signed Everything Widgets build always passes store validation.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Bypasses the Google license (Pairip) purchase check of the paid Everything Widgets app: the app runs fully without a Play purchase. Donation SKUs are cosmetic and untouched.

patches.name: Meesho: Block analytics & tracking SDKs
patches.description:
Blocks Meesho's analytics & tracking SDKs (Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer,
Adjust, Facebook AppEvents, WebEngage, CleverTap and similar) using the
same universal heuristic as 'Block analytics & tracking SDKs'.

Applies to com.meesho.supply only. Heuristic; obfuscated or
reflection-based reporting is not covered. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Meesho: Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer)
patches.description:
Stops video autoplay in the Meesho feed and product videos (ExoPlayer/Media3)
using the same heuristic as 'Disable video autoplay (ExoPlayer/Media3)'.

Applies to com.meesho.supply only. Heuristic; see the universal entry
for limitations. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Meesho: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
patches.description:
Opens links in the default external browser instead of an in-app Custom
Tab, using the same rewrite as the universal 'Prefer external browser
over Custom Tabs' patch.

Applies to com.meesho.supply only. Covers Custom Tabs /
CustomTabsIntent call sites only. Unverified on device.

patches.name: Unlock Excel
patches.description: Removes login requirement, unlocks premium, blocks ads, bypasses signature and code transparency checks.

patches.name: Unlock Word
patches.description: Removes login requirement, unlocks premium, blocks ads, bypasses signature and code transparency checks.

patches.name: Allow screenshots & screen recording
patches.description: Removes FLAG_SECURE and secure-surface flags from MUBI's players, so screenshots, screen recording and screen mirroring work. DRM-protected video may still render black on some devices.

patches.name: Block analytics & tracking
patches.description: No-ops Braze, Firebase Analytics, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook App Events and Segment logging in MUBI. Push notifications and account features keep working.

patches.name: Block upgrade & sale deep links
patches.description: Makes MUBI's upgrade screen non-exported and disables the upgrade-yearly / blackfriday / flash-sale deep links. Playback and entitlements are unchanged.

patches.name: Bypass forced update
patches.description: Neutralizes Play Core's update-availability checks so MUBI does not block startup on a newer version. Running an outdated build may break playback.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Installs MUBI beside the official app by changing the package, permission names, provider authorities and launcher label. Play Billing, Cast and Google sign-in may not work on the clone.

options.description: Package name for the cloned MUBI app.
Launcher name for the cloned MUBI app.

patches.name: Disable autoplay previews
patches.description: Stops MUBI's home/browse screens from autoplaying muted trailers and previews. Opening a title still plays normally.

patches.name: Enable picture-in-picture
patches.description: Adds PiP support to MUBI's phone/tablet player: playback continues in a floating window when you press Home.

patches.name: Force TV (leanback) UI
patches.description: Makes MUBI believe the device is a television, so Android TV boxes that misreport their form factor open the leanback UI. Do not enable on phones.

patches.name: Force highest video quality
patches.description: Reports a 1 Gbps connection to ExoPlayer/Media3 so MUBI picks the highest available rendition instead of downshifting. May increase data use and buffering on slow connections; server-side caps still apply.

patches.name: Packaging toolkit (signature, install source, MicroG)
patches.description: Applies the shared signature, install-source and GmsCore/MicroG patches to MUBI in one step. Does not bypass Play Integrity or fix Play Billing.

patches.name: Prefer external browser over Custom Tabs
patches.description: Removes MUBI's Custom Tabs service query so browser links can fall back to the normal external browser. No effect if MUBI launches Custom Tabs directly.

patches.name: Remove promo cards & upsell banners
patches.description: Disables Braze Content Cards, the Braze feed and card refreshes in MUBI. Push notifications and the app's own screens are untouched.

patches.name: Skip TV confirmation dialog
patches.description: Closes MUBI's Android TV confirmation screen before it draws. Only useful on TV devices; a flow waiting on a dialog result may stall.

patches.name: Skip pre-roll promos
patches.description: Disables MUBI's app-side pre-roll gate when it is a boolean check. Pre-roll injected by the server or embedded in the stream is unaffected.

patches.name: Spoof Widevine level for MUBI
patches.description: Reports L1 / HDCP 2.2 to MUBI's local DRM checks. Server-side licensing still decides the resolution, so HD may remain unavailable.

patches.name: Suppress subscription paywall
patches.description: Closes MUBI's upgrade screen immediately instead of showing it. Does not unlock playback or grant a subscription; only hides the upsell screen.

patches.name: Clone Netflix
patches.description: Installs the patched Netflix as a separate app alongside the stock one (package suffix .clone), instead of replacing it. Required on devices where Netflix is a preinstalled system app that can't be uninstalled (most Android TV boxes, Google TV, Fire TV). Keep the stock Netflix installed + enabled — the clone borrows its signature to pass Netflix's native tamper check (stock auto-updating is fine). You just launch the clone instead. Recommended: leave ON.

patches.name: Disable Netflix CertCheck
patches.description: Neutralises Netflix's DexGuard signing-certificate anti-tamper check so a re-signed build doesn't self-crash on launch. Required for every Netflix patch.

patches.name: Minimize Network Fingerprint
patches.description: Blanks the local IP / MAC / Wi-Fi SSID the Netflix app reports about your network (keeps interface name/type) and stops the app from reporting your advertising ID (GAID) in its ad-collection telemetry. Reduces network + ad fingerprinting. Does NOT stop the server-side "I'm traveling"/household check (that's driven by your public IP — use a VPN for that). Opt-in / experimental; test on-device.

patches.name: Remove Netflix ads (bundle engine)
patches.description: Bundles the in-process ad-kill script (killads.js) and its loader into the app. This is the ad remover: at launch the app runs the script itself (script mode — no PC, no root, no frida server) and empties Netflix's ad breaks (pre-roll, mid-roll) and the pause-screen ad overlay. Pairs with the loader patch. Default ON.

patches.name: Remove Netflix ads (loader)
patches.description: Arms the ad remover: injects the startup call that loads the in-process ad-kill engine (bundled by the companion patch) as early as possible, so ads are emptied before playback. Requires the bundle-engine patch. Default ON.

patches.name: Suppress Household Prompt
patches.description: Hides the Netflix "you're traveling" / update-your-household prompt by keeping the client from activating the misdetection challenge session. Does NOT change what Netflix's servers detect (that's driven by your public IP — use a VPN for that); it only suppresses the on-screen prompt. Opt-in / experimental; only takes visible effect when the account would otherwise be prompted.

patches.name: Privacy: block trackers & analytics
patches.description: Suppresses ChatGPT product analytics, Statsig events/exposures, Segment event dispatch and Bitdrift crash/session-replay startup; disables Datadog RUM and removes ad-ID/install-referrer access. Chat, login, files and push notifications are preserved. Core service requests and server-side logging cannot be disabled by an APK patch.

patches.name: Privacy: no location, contacts or phone data
patches.description: Removes ChatGPT's location, contacts, phone-state and SMS-send permissions. Location-based answers, contact lookup, phone-state access and direct SMS sending are disabled. Call/voice-assistant framework permissions, chat, files and push notifications are preserved.

patches.name: Privacy: no mic or camera
patches.description: Removes RECORD_AUDIO, CAMERA, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MICROPHONE plus all camera/microphone uses-feature declarations from the manifest. Voice Mode and camera capture become impossible (not merely denied - the grant dialog itself is gone). File storage, notifications and everything else are untouched.

patches.name: Ad-free feed (remove promoted Pins)
patches.description: Removes promoted/sponsored Pins from every feed, search result, and board list during deserialization, so they never render. Organic pinning, boards and saving are unaffected.

patches.name: Block analytics and data collection
patches.description: No-ops Firebase screen/event tracking and AppsFlyer attribution + event logging (concrete SDK entry points, verified in 14.41.0). Push notifications keep working; Pinterest features are untouched.

patches.name: Enable media downloads
patches.description: Enables the pin-level image download eligibility flag. Use the separate experimental video download patch for supported video Pins.

patches.name: Enable video download
patches.description: Experimental: enables the download row on video Pins and saves an available MP4. Streaming-only or unavailable videos are reported instead of saved as images.

patches.name: Unlock Lifetime
patches.description: Unlocks all Lifetime features in Proxyman.

patches.name: Block AutoMod comments
patches.description: Hides all comments from u/AutoModerator, including stickied bot comments. AutoModerator posts are kept. Client-side only; off by default.

patches.name: Content filters
patches.description: Adds patch-time keyword, community, author and flair filters for feed posts (optionally comments), and locally bypasses Reddit's NSFW/spoiler/quarantine gates and over-18 account flags. Server-side filtering still applies. Off by default.

options.description: Comma-separated words or phrases hidden from titles, bodies and flairs (case-insensitive, literal match).
Comma-separated subreddit names, with or without the r/ prefix.
Comma-separated user names, with or without the u/ prefix.
Comma-separated flair texts. Use community::flair to scope a rule to one community.
Hide a row when any rule matches, or only when every configured category matches.

patches.name: Disable Reddit video autoplay
patches.description: Forces Reddit's video autoplay preference to 'Never' so videos only play after a tap. Scoped to Reddit; off by default.

patches.name: Employee Debug Flags
patches.description: Spoofs is_employee locally at the Account JSON adapter, exposing Reddit's internal employee/debug UI menus (mostly non-functional without the employee backend, and a few may misbehave — enable for exploration only). Off by default.

patches.name: Hide crossposts

patches.name: Hide live streams

patches.name: Hide read posts
patches.description: Hides posts Reddit has marked as read/visited in feeds and listings. Client-side only; off by default.

patches.name: Open Reddit links in external browser
patches.description: Opens outbound Reddit links in the default external browser instead of Reddit's in-app Custom Tab. Falls back to the in-app tab if launching fails. Off by default.

patches.name: Reddit: Diagnostic crash log
patches.description: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - writes the full stack trace to Downloads/reddit-crash-*.txt when the app crashes, for remote diagnosis. Off by default; enable when asked to produce a crash log. Installs on the first account sync after launch; crashes before that are not captured. Chain-forwards to the original crash handler.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted posts in feeds and banner ads in comment threads.

patches.name: Show deleted posts and comments

patches.name: Unlock Premium

release_notes:
Proteus Patches v2.3.0 (pre-release re-cut)

> Supersedes the earlier `v2.3.0` pre-release re-cut by adding the **Instagram settings, Ghost Mode, Reels controls, like-animation and browser-tool patches** on top of the Instagram `439.0.0.37.89` suite, the Meesho package targeting fixes, Amazon Business + WebView AdBlock/autoplay + screenshot-detection fixes, and Mereframe `0.8.4` (`vc 118`) BTI/PAC-safe native `.so` integrity and Pro patches. No on-device runtime testing has been performed in this re-cut — marked as **pre-release**; `v2.2.9` remains the latest full release.

## Changes in this re-cut

### Instagram (`com.instagram.android` `439.0.0.37.89`, APKM)
Added 23 patches (`ARM64_V8A: 384510827`, `ARMEABI_V7A: 384510838`), 4 shared helpers, and 15 extension classes under `app.template.extension.extension` (10 new):
- **Distraction-Free (17 patches)**: `Hide ads`, `Hide suggested content` (`hideSuggestedReels`, `hideSuggestedStories`, `hideHighlightStories`, `hideSuggestedAccount`), `Limit feed to following profiles`, `Hide explore feed`, `Hide navigation buttons` (`hideHome`, `hideReels`, `hideDirect`, `hideSearch`, `hideProfile`, `hideCreate`), `Disable Reels scrolling`, `Disable video autoplay`, `Disable story auto flipping`, `Hide all stories`, `Hide feed content`, `Hide notes tray`, `Hide Instants`, `Hide reshare button`, `Hide Reels save button`, `Hide Threads profile button`, `Reels playback speed menu`, and `Reels double-tap seek`.
- **Misc (6 patches)**: `Bypass signature check`, `Remove build expired popup`, `Clone` (package/app-name renaming with `CONST_STRING` + `CONST_STRING_JUMBO`, permissions, `android:taskAffinity`, and provider authority rewriting), `Proteus settings`, `Ghost mode`, and `Change like animation` (experimental, off by default).
- **Proteus settings**: Adds a gear and a ghost button to the main feed action bar. The programmatic dialog controls the chronological feed, Ghost Mode sub-switches, Reels toggles, the like-animation picker, and three WebView tools. Settings live in the app-private `proteus_instagram_settings` file.
- **Ghost mode**: Hides typing indicators (`85450::68`, `85450::69`, `115516::0`, `115516::1`, `99511::0`), suppresses the `mark_thread_seen-` DM receipt path, and best-effort blocks the story seen endpoint in the Tigon request layer.
- **Reels controls**: `Reels playback speed menu` enables `109947::0` / `109947::2`; `Reels double-tap seek` enables `118405::1` / `118405::5` / `118405::6`. Both are switchable at runtime and stay on by default.
- **Chronological feed**: `Limit feed to following profiles` now also disables `p92_android_ranked_following_feed:is_enabled` (`108494::0`) and honours the runtime toggle. Runtime MobileConfig overrides are applied only to flags registered by a selected patch.
- **Like animation**: Experimental port of piko's enum-to-native-renderer bridge with piko's animation list and a random-per-process choice.
- **Like animation — register-pressure fix**: The patch previously failed to apply with `app.morphe.patcher.patch.PatchException: No free registers available` (`FreeRegisterProvider.getFreeRegister`), because `XDTUserActivationMetadataImpl.<init>` is register saturated on `439.0.0.37.89` and the patch asked for two scratch registers. It now requests a single 4-bit register (required by the `move-result-object` 11x instruction), carries the `Boolean` "explicit choice" flag in the `p2` parameter register and writes the selected animation back into the `p1` parameter with `move-object/from16` — the same approach as upstream piko. The original animation is preserved when no animation is selected, and `InstagramLikeAnimation.changeLikeAnimation` returns the incoming default instead of `null` on error.
- **Browser tools**: In-app WebView entry points for logged-out public browsing, a profile's public Reels tab, and your own liked posts.
- **Attributions**: Added GPLv3 §7(b) notices in `META-INF/PROTEUS-NOTICE.txt` for `brosssh/morphe-patches`, `brosssh/instagram-morphe-patches-library`, and `crimera/piko`.
- **Limits**: Another user's liked Reels and true logged-out native app use are server-enforced; the browser tools are the documented fallback. The action-bar, DM-seen and like-animation fingerprints are name/string anchored and not yet device-verified on `439.0.0.37.89`; treat the like-animation patch as experimental.

### Mereframe (`app.unnamed.rawrecording` `0.8.4` / vc `118`)
- **Bypass native integrity checks** (`#5` / PR `#33`): Patches all five ARM64 integrity check entry points in `lib/arm64-v8a/libunnamed_raw.so` (`isIntegrityOk@0x23f3d8`, `checkApkAssets@0x2a5ecc`, `checkMapsDbg@0x2bf304`, `checkSoMaps@0x2e5fb0`, `checkEnvSig@0x2e1b54`) using BTI/PAC-safe `bti jc; mov w0, #1; ret` stubs verified at globally unique 96-byte prologues, while keeping `MereframeIntegrityHook.openSessionWithFallback` active on `B1e6ad8077f6880e309d8da4b;->d(ZZZZFZ)[J`.
- **Unlock Pro features**: Unlocks `LQu;->k` & `LQu;->m`, all `Bf1c089a4a0abf0794ad7a6f9` license/session gates (`e`, `g`, `b`, `c`, `i`, `h`, `d` returning valid `Leq(1L, Lvy.u(p1))`), and native gates `verifySessionHandle@0x242048` + `isProEntitled@0x244680` in `libunnamed_raw.so`.

### Amazon (`com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping`, `com.amazon.mShop.android.business.shopping`, `in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping`)
- **Amazon Business + Shopping `32.19.0.100`** (`#21` / PR `#31`): Added `com.amazon.mShop.android.business.shopping` (`32.19.0.451`, `32.20.0.451`) across all Amazon patches and added Shopping `32.19.0.100`.
- **Disable screenshot detection**: New default-on patch neutralizing `Activity.registerScreenCaptureCallback` / `unregisterScreenCaptureCallback` with `nop` (avoiding single-instruction `try` block `VerifyError`).
- **Remove ads**: Expanded `AmazonHelper.AD_SELECTORS` to 102 unique CSS selectors (merging `hxreborn/amznkiller` selectors) and hooked `MShopWebViewContainer.onPageFinished` + `InteractionWebFragment.onFragmentPostShown`.
- **Disable video autoplay**: Added DOM/JS autoplay guard (`AmazonHelper.injectDisableVideoAutoplay`) alongside `setMediaPlaybackRequiresUserGesture(true)` across `MShopWebViewClient.onPageFinished`, `MShopWebViewContainer.onPageFinished`, and `InteractionWebFragment.onFragmentPostShown`.

### Meesho (`com.meesho.supply`)
- **Package ID fix** (`#32`): Updated Meesho target package from `com.meesho.shopping` to `com.meesho.supply` (`29.5`–`29.9`) across `Constants.kt`, scoped patch descriptions, `docs/MEESHO.md`, and generated catalog metadata.

## Verification
- CI compiled `:extensions:extension` and `:patches:buildAndroid`, passed `test_pinterest_video_urls.sh`, `test_instagram_extension.sh` (including the new runtime-flag, Ghost filter, MobileConfig gating, browser-URL and animation-label checks), `:patches:check` (`testPermissionRemoval`, `testBravePrivacy`, `testInstagram`), `generatePatchesList`, `.github/scripts` Python tests, `verify_patch_source.py`, and `verify_android_bundle.py`.
- `testInstagram` includes a regression test that rebuilds the register-saturated `XDTUserActivationMetadataImpl.<init>` frame, asserts the old two-register request fails with `No free registers available`, and asserts the single 4-bit register request succeeds.
- Not yet tested on physical Android hardware.

- Bundle: `patches-2.3.0.mpp` (2502038 bytes)
